title: Concrete in the Cauldron
description: Turn concrete powder into concrete using a water cauldron — no rivers or oceans needed.
body:
Tired of running to the nearest body of water every time you need concrete? This plugin adds a simple and immersive way to get it done: just right-click a water cauldron while holding concrete powder and watch it harden within seconds — right where you stand.

Supports all 16 colors of concrete. Each use drains one level of water from the cauldron. Comes with smoke particle effects and sounds for a satisfying experience.

## Features:

- Works with all 16 colors of concrete powder
- Cauldron loses one water level per use
- Smoke particles and sound effects
- Protection against double-triggering
